items.briefing:
Home batteries and solar systems are increasingly being flagged as a cybersecurity compliance concern for Australian organisations. If your workplace has energy storage or smart energy devices connected to your network, these may now fall under security obligations — it's worth checking with your IT team whether these devices are properly secured and managed.

On a broader note, AI tools are creating new challenges for traditional security approaches, making it harder to control what systems can access. If your organisation uses AI-powered tools, ensure staff understand they should only be used through approved, work-sanctioned platforms.

**Tip:** Check whether any smart devices at your workplace — including energy systems — are on your organisation's approved and secured device list.

featured.title: Australia's home batteries are now a cybersecurity compliance isue
featured.summary: Millions of rooftop batteries are now subject to mandatory cyber standards as Canberra widens scrutiny of grid-connected home devices.
